evals.prompt: I manage the Florida location - in the next 26 weeks, are there any significant shortfalls in products (Materials) happening?
evals.expected_output: Defaults to Scenario 1 without asking; bounded full-horizon read if practical; after a broad timeout no 26-week fallback; says exactly which weeks/materials were verified and never calls a partial read complete.

evals.prompt: In Florida DC Scenario 1, check Week 2 FY25 material shortages only.
evals.expected_output: Only one week and one location; distinguishes unmet demand from negative forecast inventory; no all-sites/all-weeks search.

evals.prompt: Given the previously identified short materials, which finished goods are affected?
evals.expected_output: Uses full supplied PDF and exact code matching; states previous shortfall data was prior-read; does not rerun broad inventory read.

evals.prompt: Which location has the biggest excess for the Florida materials we flagged?
evals.expected_output: Reads donor excess only for flagged materials and weeks; no PO scan; does not assert transfer feasibility.

evals.prompt: Are any committed POs for those Florida shortage materials worth pulling forward?
evals.expected_output: Searches only relevant open committed lines; checks date staleness; does not reread 26-week inventory forecast or alter POs.
